name: integration-more
description: More integrations band for the integration detail pages: eyebrow, heading and lede with a 'View All Integrations' outline button, over a row of up to four cards, each a partner logo + the Asset Panda PRO panda mark with the integration's name, linking to that integration's page. Figma: Integrations Detail Page Template > Problem Section (7318:171385).

eyebrow.description: Small label above the heading (shown in capitals).

title.default: More ways to connect the tools you rely on.

lede.default: Explore other integrations that bring asset management closer to the systems your business uses every day.

cta_label.description: Outline button text. Renders only with cta_url.

brand_logo.description: Mark shown after the + on every card. Empty uses the kit's Asset Panda PRO panda (assets/panda-pro.svg).

items.description: Integrations to show; the first four with a name are used. Each: name (required), url (the integration's page; the card is a link only when set), icon (partner logo URL, square icon or wordmark — drawn up to 64px tall and 104px wide).
